```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(salmonMSE)
library(here)
library(kableExtra)

# Get SR benchmarks (this file must be sourced to create csv file)

# source(here("98-ExtractMSY.R"))
```

## Benchmarks


```{r benchmarks, echo=FALSE}
BenchFull <- read.csv(file = here("data", "BenchmarksFull_NatPops.csv"))

kable(BenchFull, 
      caption = "Table 1. Populaton-level benchmarks, with SMAX estimated from the conditioning model", booktabs = TRUE) %>% 
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top") %>% 
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

# Alternative
BenchSimple <- read.csv(file = here("data", "BenchmarksSimple_NatPops.csv"))

kable(BenchSimple, 
      caption = "Table 1. Populaton-level benchmarks", booktabs = TRUE) %>% 
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top") %>% 
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

```

```{r habitatCapacity, echo=FALSE}
#   values_to = "Value") %>% 
#   select("Stock", "WA", "Benchmark", "Value")



Srep_hab <- as.data.frame(
  read.csv(
    here("data", "UpperSoGChinook_out_posteriorpredictive_NEWWA.csv"))
)  %>%  select("Stock", "WA", "SREP_median", "SREP_lwr5", "SREP_upr95") %>% 
  rename(Population = "Stock", WatershedArea = "WA", SREP = "SREP_median", 
         lwr = "SREP_lwr5", upr = "SREP_upr95")

colnames(Srep_hab) <- c("Population", "Watershed area (km2)", "SREP", "lower CI", "upper CI")

kable(Srep_hab, 
      caption = "Table 2. Integrated accesible watershed-area model estimates of SREP",
      booktabs = TRUE,
      escape = FALSE) %>% 
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top") %>% 
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

```


```{r smax, echo=FALSE}

Smax_hab <- as.data.frame(
  read.csv(
    here("data", "UpperSoGChinook_out_posteriorpredictive_NEWWA.csv"))
) %>% select("Stock", "WA", "SMAX_median", "SMAX_lwr5", "SMAX_upr95") %>% 
  rename(Population = "Stock", WatershedArea = "WA", SMAX = "SMAX_median", 
         lwr = "SMAX_lwr5", upr = "SMAX_upr95")

colnames(Smax_hab) <- c("Population", "Watershed area (km2)", "SMAX", "lower CI", "upper CI")

kable(Smax_hab,
      caption = "Table 2. Integrated accesible watershed-area model estimates of SMAX", 
      booktabs = TRUE) %>% 
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top") %>% 
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)


```
